gaps.sentence: With careful ___ (PREPARE), the trek is perfectly safe.
The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.

gaps.explanation: 'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).

gaps.explanation: The subject is 'botany'; a specialist is a 'botanist'.

gaps.sentence: She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.
